subject: QMon onboarding: prompt + eval integration and phased rollback matrix
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@helio.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@helio.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood QMon pilot kickoff and success metrics

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Helio is excited to move forward with the QMon pilot focused on our patient triage assistant. We want to validate that Redwood's monitoring will surface regression risk for the prompt variants we're shipping next month.

High-level asks from our side:
- Baseline eval run against current prompt set (attached): 15K weighted queries
- Real-time regression alerting via the eval harness on deploys to staging
- Canary window + rollback policy for model variant rollouts (we plan two variants)

Can we set up a short alignment call next week to agree on the prompt/eval mapping, alert thresholds, and the exact canary stop criteria? Rajiv will be the product lead on our side.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Product Lead, Helio Health
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@helio.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood QMon pilot kickoff and success metrics

Hi Emily — welcome aboard.

Attached are three artifacts to kick off: the prompt set you sent (helio_promptset_v1.csv) with our initial tagging, an integration play (qmon-eval-harness-integration.md) that describes the webhook + batch eval flow, and a starter canary/rollback matrix (canary-rollback-matrix.xlsx).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Alignment call (30 min): Monday 9/18 10am PT — confirm mapping of prompt buckets to evals and set thresholds.
2) Baseline run: we will run the eval harness against the V1 prompt set on a staging snapshot (estimated 6–8 hours compute).
3) Canary plan: deploy variant A to 10% traffic for 4 hours; monitor latency and the three quality signals in the matrix (intent accuracy, hallucination rate, top3 answer drift). If any signal crosses the threshold X for two consecutive 15m windows, we trigger rollback to baseline.

Marissa from CS is looping in to coordinate the engagement and runbooks; Karthik will confirm runtime footprint and whether we need a dedicated batch window.

I also included a short checklist at the bottom of the integration doc for your SREs to allow webhook access and for us to provision an eval queue.

See you on Monday — thanks!

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — added a quick engagement outline and CS-side owners below.

Engagement timeline (tentative):

- Week 2 (canary): staged variant rollout + daily regression digest; refine thresholds

CS owners: Marissa Cole (engagement lead), Soojin Lee (onboarding + quality ops), Karthik Iyer (runtime/infra contact).

- Share API keys for staging eval queue or approve our test keys

Karthik — can you confirm whether the baseline run needs dedicated Dedicated pool time or will fit into our shared batch window? If we need dedicated capacity for the 15K weighted queries, please share ETA and cost estimate and I'll flag it to procurement.

On quoting Soojin's note:
> If any signal crosses the threshold X for two consecutive 15m windows, we trigger rollback to baseline.

I propose we also add an automatic alert to the Helio Slack channel and a one-click rollback link in the Console for the pilot. Emily, is that acceptable for your SREs?

— Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily@helio.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood QMon pilot kickoff and success metrics

Quick technical confirmation and a few constraints from infra:

- Baseline run: 15K weighted queries fits our shared batch window but will consume ~3 hours of GPU time under current queue load. If Helio wants an isolated, contiguous run we can schedule a Dedicated slot (est. 4 hours) — cost delta ~ +$280.

- Eval harness integration: the attached MD has details. Webhook-driven evaluation works; we recommend a hybrid approach — periodic batch re-eval for coverage plus streaming checks for canary traffic. Streaming checks should use token-sampled telemetry (1% sample) to keep latency impact low.

- Signals and thresholds (initial suggestions):
  - Intent accuracy: drop > 4 percentage points vs baseline over two consecutive 15m windows -> alert
  - Hallucination rate: increase > 3 percentage points absolute over baseline -> alert
  - Top3 answer drift (semantic similarity): median similarity decline > 0.07 -> alert

- Canary windows and rollback: 10% traffic for 4 hours (as proposed). Rollback triggers: any two distinct signals breaching thresholds in 30 minutes OR sustained latency regression > 20% P95. We implement an automated rollback API call; the Console will show a rollback button which calls the API and posts to Helio's configured Slack channel.

- Deliverables before Monday call: I will upload a sample canary monitoring dashboard and a scripted rollback play (will attach to the Drive link).

Thanks — I expect no blocking issues.
